outlook.statement: The Directors are continuously looking for the new avenues for future growth of the Company and expect more growth in future period.

The management is confident of improvement in the company's working in the near future with fast growth. The scenario of the finance industry and economy in general is buoyant even after the industry is exposed to competition with policy of the government. The process of development, increasing trust of the government on the finance industry, the future of industry appears quite bright.
The Directors are hopeful for the better and better performance in the future.
